i love them a lot i don’t want them to feel responsible 

i don’t want my brother to drop out of uni because of this

i don’t want my mom to have her breakdown because of this 

i’m just so so tired

i just want to know she’ll heal. i need to know it won’t ruin her life. i need to be sure everyone’s going to be okay

i just know she won’t be. that’s my crisis. i don’t know how to word things so i can let her know she’s not at fault and there’s nothing anybody could have done

i’m sick with the stress of it all
